sentences.en: Hereditary Prince Alois is the regent of Liechtenstein.
sentences.zh: 阿洛伊斯亲王是列支敦士登的摄政者。

sentences.en: Queen Mary has been appointed regent until King Tom becomes old enough to assume the throne.
sentences.zh: 玛丽女王被任命为摄政，直到国王汤姆年满可以继承王位为止。

sentences.en: The regent signed the new law on behalf of the absent king.
sentences.zh: 摄政者代表缺席的国王签署了新法律。

senses.zh: 摄政者；摄政王；[美]州立大学董事会董事；[古]统治者
